Name: Launch Date
Description: Date the product went on sale

Name: Net Amount
Description: Invoiced amount after discounts, before tax

Name: Return Flag
Description: TRUE when the line is a customer return

Name: Sales YoY %
Expression: VAR _ly = CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'Date'[Date] ) ) RETURN DIVIDE ( [Total Sales] - _ly, _ly )
